SKILL.md content:
Review diffs for unnecessary complexity. One line per finding: location, what
to cut, what replaces it. The diff's best outcome is getting shorter.

## Format

`L<line>: <tag> <what>. <replacement>.`, or `<file>:L<line>: ...` for
multi-file diffs.

Tags:

- `delete:` dead code, unused flexibility, speculative feature. Replacement: nothing.
- `stdlib:` hand-rolled thing the standard library ships. Name the function.
- `native:` dependency or code doing what the platform already does. Name the feature.
- `yagni:` abstraction with one implementation, config nobody sets, layer with one caller.
- `shrink:` same logic, fewer lines. Show the shorter form.

## Examples

❌ "This EmailValidator class might be more complex than necessary, have you
considered whether all these validation rules are needed at this stage?"

✅ `L12-38: stdlib: 27-line validator class. "@" in email, 1 line, real validation is the confirmation mail.`

✅ `L4: native: moment.js imported for one format call. Intl.DateTimeFormat, 0 deps.`

✅ `repo.py:L88: yagni: AbstractRepository with one implementation. Inline it until a second one exists.`

✅ `L52-71: delete: retry wrapper around an idempotent local call. Nothing replaces it.`

✅ `L30-44: shrink: manual loop builds dict. dict(zip(keys, values)), 1 line.`

## Scoring

End with the only metric that matters: `net: -<N> lines possible.`

If there is nothing to cut, say `Lean already. Ship.` and stop.

## Boundaries

Scope: over-engineering and complexity only. Correctness bugs, security holes,
and performance are explicitly out of scope. Route them to a normal review
pass, not this one. A single smoke test or `assert`-based
self-check is the ponytail minimum, not bloat, never flag it for deletion.

Do **not** flag cleansing structure as `yagni` / `shrink` / `delete`:
documented domain layers (`pipeline.py` vs `service.py` vs `repo.py`),
predicate tuples + `any_of` for independent guards, a named process-owner
object instead of module globals, one helper that replaced a copied branch.
`yagni: layer with one caller` does not apply to those layers when they are
the project's map. Dead *features* (unused flag, zero-caller helper, twin
function) still get `delete:`.

Does not apply the fixes, only lists them.
"stop ponytail-review" or "normal mode": revert to verbose review style.

PR **#14** (`cursor/phase1-team-docs-8e82`) — admin team docs. Repo/service/route split stays.

`migrations.py:L135-183:` yagni: `team_doc_folders` + `parent_id` + seed loop for four fixed names and no folder CRUD. `folder TEXT CHECK (folder IN ('product','business','marketing','tech'))` on `team_docs`.

`repo.py:L6-55:` delete: `_folder_row`, `list_folders`, `get_folder`. Nothing replaces them once folder is a slug.

`service.py:L68-87:` shrink: nested `children`/`attach` tree. Group docs by the four slugs, ~8 lines.

`service.py:L7,L24-32:` shrink: `_slugify` runs `_SLUG_RE` twice. `re.sub(...).strip("-")[:_SLUG_MAX].strip("-")`; raise if empty.

`service.py:L42-52:` delete: `exclude_id` never passed. Drop the kwarg and the `== exclude_id` branches.

`service.py:L138-139:` shrink: `base` then `next_slug` are the same. `next_slug = _slugify(requested) if requested else current["slug"]`.

`admin-docs.js:L17-24,L30,L41,L50,L58:` delete: `flattenFolders`, `--docs-depth`, recursive `renderTree`. `tree.folders` is flat.

`admin-docs.js:L1:` delete: unused `escapeAttr`. Drop it from the import.

`admin-docs.js:L129-132:` shrink: second click listener. Fold delete into the first click handler.

`app-shell.css:L450-452:` delete: `--docs-depth` indent. No nested folders.

`postgres_mock.py:L175:` delete: `team_docs` in `_TRACKING_TABLES`. It is not per-user tracking; keep it only in `_DATA_TABLES`.

net: -110 lines possible.
